description: NHFLOW semi-implicit step (A 510 11, A 520 2, A 536 0.01) with a piston wavemaker over the whole depth (X 10 4, X 170, wavemaker.dat: stroke 4 cm, T 1.5 s, ramp of 3 periods): the columns of the paddle are walls of the solve, their faces to the water carry the discharge of the moving wall (NHFLOW_SI_6DOF v43).
